description.value: The Wells Hotel is a heritage country inn that has anchored the small gold-rush town of Wells, BC since 1934, operating as the primary accommodation provider in the area. It sits at the gateway to Barkerville Historic Town, Bowron Lakes Canoe Chain, and Troll Ski Resort, making it a natural overnight stop for touring cyclists exploring the Cariboo region. The hotel features 13 guest rooms, a rooftop hot tub, and an on-site pub and restaurant notable for BC craft beer and one of the largest single-malt Scotch collections in Western Canada.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and describes a heritage hotel open year-round since 1934 in Wells, BC. Free WiFi and complimentary continental breakfast are explicitly stated; the on-site pub and restaurant confirm evening food on premises. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific facilities anywhere on the site.
